name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: Displays conversational content with variants, grouping, reactions, and polymorphic surfaces.

motionProfile.reason: One message introduces itself and then limits motion to the fragments, own box, overlay anchors and reactions that actually change.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Bubble owns the message, group and reaction-overlay insertion envelopes at their own retained hosts; a parent entrance consumes the same cause instead of adding a second one.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Bubble fades a retained reaction overlay on removal; the message itself leaves with its caller-owned parent, so no separate outgoing copy is produced.

layout.move/one-shot.reason: Bubble composes one bounded displacement for its own message box and for the reaction overlay between two committed anchors; the resting reaction placement translate stays the positional writer.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Bubble measures its content block size and its independent reaction-overlay box once per committed revision; a caller-fixed axis and a composed child stay native.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Bubble replaces changed runs in a direct plain message display and a direct plain reaction display; composed rich children keep their own owners.

number.roll/reels.reason: Bubble reels a direct numeric display value in the message content and the reaction overlay in its existing format; identifiers, timestamps and dates stay text.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Bubble owns the content surface paint and the reaction overlay surface paint, with the explicit display foreground on each retained text span.
